block.web_search.model.title: Web Search
block.web_search.model.description: Search the web with SearXNG, Brave or SerpAPI, and Wikipedia.
block.web_search.security_hint: Each query goes only to the selected provider. API keys stay in the wallet, and result pages are never fetched.
block.web_search.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.web_search.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.web_search.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, no query is sent to any provider.
block.web_search.help_provider: The one service this node contacts. Wikipedia needs no key; Brave and SerpAPI need an API key in the wallet; SearXNG needs your instance URL.
block.web_search.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding the Brave subscription token or the SerpAPI key, never the key itself.
block.web_search.help_searxng_url: Base URL of your SearXNG instance. Its settings must list json in search.formats.
block.web_search.help_allow_private_netw: Allow a SearXNG instance on loopback or a private LAN address. Link-local and cloud metadata addresses stay refused.
block.web_search.help_allow_insecure_htt: Allow an http:// SearXNG URL. Queries then travel unencrypted; use it only on a trusted network.
block.web_search.help_count: Default number of results; a query can ask for 1 to 20.
block.web_search.help_language: Default language code such as en, fr or pt-br. Empty: provider default (English Wikipedia).
block.web_search.help_region: Default two-letter country code such as US or FR. Empty: provider default.
block.web_search.help_safe_search: Default adult-content filter. SerpAPI sends no filter for Moderate (Google default).
block.web_search.help_time_range: Default freshness filter. Wikipedia search has none.
block.web_search.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one search, including SearXNG pages and retry waits.
block.web_search.help_max_pages: Most SearXNG result pages one search may request to fill the asked results.
block.web_search.help_max_retries: Retries after HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx or a network failure. Quota and key errors are never retried.
block.web_search.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A Retry-After above this value returns a rate_limited error instead of waiting.
block.web_search.help_max_response_bytes: Larger provider responses are refused as protocol errors.
block.web_search.help_max_text_chars: Longest snippet or Wikipedia extract kept; longer text is cut at a word boundary.
block.web_search.help_api_base_url: Keep empty to use the official API. Only a loopback test double may replace it.
block.web_search.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for an https:// SearXNG instance or an HTTPS loopback test double. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
